titles: Why MCP Matters for Wouri Express
youtube.description:
Wouri Express has three systems and two AI models that need them. Tanyi explains how the Model Context Protocol (MCP) simplifies connections, making it easier to switch providers without rebuilding. Learn why this standard matters for reliable AI integration.

0:42 Decide: custom code or a standard

2:02 Constraint and fix
2:34 User test
2:54 Where this applies
3:05 Ownership

Fictional teaching scenario. Wouri Express and its people are invented; the setting draws on documented conditions in Douala, Cameroon. MCP facts: the Model Context Protocol is an open standard published by Anthropic in November 2024.
Complex AI. Explained visually. Built practically.
